nom: Exuviance Gentle Cream Face Cleanser + Makeup Remover

segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin, including several with rosacea, report the cleanser does not strip, irritate, or cause breakouts; a minority, especially after a reported reformulation, describe burning, rashes, or irritation.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently describe the cream cleanser as hydrating and non-stripping, leaving skin soft rather than tight, and helpful for flakiness; one reviewer with normal-to-dry skin instead found it left an oily feeling and did not deep clean.
segments.combination: The reviewers with combination skin, one of them acne-prone, report it cleans without drying out their skin.
segments.oily: Two reviewers who describe their skin as also oily or acne-prone say the cleanser did not sting and helped avoid breakouts, without adding excess oil.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cleanser as non-stripping and hydrating, leaving skin soft rather than tight; a small number instead report dryness, irritation, or a burning sensation, particularly after a reported reformulation.
concerns.redness: A reviewer with rosacea reports fewer flares and reduced redness after three weeks of use; a couple of others with sensitive skin also report no redness, while one reviewer developed a rash around her mouth.
concerns.barrier: One long-time rosacea sufferer reports a noticeable strengthening of her skin's barrier and fewer flare-ups after three weeks of daily use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including some with acne-prone or sensitive skin, report fewer breakouts or clearer skin over time; one reviewer says the product made her break out badly at first before her skin cleared up significantly.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers describe a slightly greasy feel or residue if not rinsed with warm water, and one reviewer says the cream did not clean well enough and left an oily feeling, while a reviewer with oily and sensitive skin says it did not add oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Leaves slight residue with cool water
Does not fully remove eye or waterproof makeup
Fragrance bothers a minority of sensitive users

extraits.texte: I have used this product for years and loved it -- It was perfect for my super sensitive skin. Unfortunately, when they changed the packaging this last time, they changed the product and added Propylene glycol. That chemical is nasty and makes my skin burn and rash, and it is in EVERYTHING now and being promoted as an anti-aging miracle. Appears it is now marked down as they are discontinuing it. I have loved Exuviance but they have gradually eliminated all the products that I used and replaced them with products that are not truly for sensitive people.

Definitely not for those with sensitive skin. I gave two stars because it felt really nice the first two days so I think it could work well for those that aren't the same skin type as me. However, for me after about 3 days a rash developed around my mouth. It was painful and took about two weeks to clear up completely. I definitely wouldn't recommend it for everyone..

I have been struggling with acne for the past 3 years. Im not sure why, but I have tried literally every product that has been recommended to me, and I've given each a fair amount of time, as I know nothing is a quick fix. I decided to ask on a whim while in the store for a facial cleaner that had nothing in it, just something to clean my face without causing more breakouts, purging, etc. The girl walked me over to this, I purchased without any hopes of anything more than just a cleanser for sensitive skin. Well let me tell you…this stuff is a miracle in a bottle. I know how extra that sounds, but I've using this once a day at night before bedtime, paired with Drunk Elephant protini cream for the past several weeks..and my face hasnt been this clear, soft and young looking in YEARS. Its a little pricey for face wash…but definitely worth a try. Buy it. If this continues to work this well for me, im a customer forever.

I have strugggled for many years to find a cleanser that would not irritate my very sensitive, reactive skin. In my youth I had extremely oily skin and struggled with acne but, a lot of the products prescribed and/or recommended dried out my skin, caused irritation, redness and sometimes itchiness. I have used foaming cleansers for most of my life but I really prefer the feel and texture of a creamy cleanser. I have another creamy cleanser that I have used in the past and it worked very well but the fragrance was just too much for my sensitive skin so I stopped using the brand all together. I have read some reviews that stated this product does not have a fragrance to it but unless the formula has changed recently my creamy cleanser has a very pleasant scent to it and it does not irritate my skin. I agree with some of the other reviewers that it does not remove all of your makeup (I wear Estée Lauder's Double Wear Foundation) but for me it does remove I would say about 95% of my makeup. I will use a soft wash cloth dampened with warm (not very warm next to hot) water to softly remove the cleanser and whatever makeup, dirt, pollution and oils that are on my skin at the end of the day. I also use the same cleanser in the morning but, can just rinse off with warm water, pat my face and neck dry and my skin is very clean and soft. No film or residue left! If you'd have sensitive and/or reactive skin, give this cleanser a try you might be pleasantly surprised. Oh, a little product

For the past three years, I have found some solace and satisfaction with Avene. However, a recent discovery has shifted my loyalty to Exuviance's Gentle Cream Cleanser. After just three weeks of daily use, this cleanser has seriously exceeded my stringent requirements, proving to be a testament to my complexion. It effectively removes impurities, makeup, and daily grime without stripping my skin of its natural moisture. Instead, my face feels wonderfully clean, supple, and remarkably soothed after each wash. What sets this cleanser apart is its impact on my skin's barrier! My sensitive skin, particularly with rosacea, often leads to compromised barrier integrity and an increased susceptibility to redness, inflammation, and breakouts. In the short span of three weeks, I've noticed a significant strengthening of my skin's barrier, which has led to fewer rosacea flares and a noticeable reduction in breakouts. The large 7.2-ounce tube is another aspect that deserves commendation. Given the small amount needed for each use, I anticipate this cleanser will last for several months, even with twice-daily application (morning and evening). I've waited to review this product after a month of using daily. This has been hands down been my favorite cleansers ever. It leaves my skin feeling ULTRA hydrated & clean. I have VERY dry skin & usually my face feels like I need moisturizer immediately after cleansing, but this has taken that away. My skin feels so healthy & balanced. I will be repurchasing over and over.

this is my go to daily cleanser. i have combination skin, and quite acne prone, so this cleanser really is just a miracle in a bottle for me. its gentle and not stripping, it soothes my redness & acne, which is a big pro for me. i feel like this is a good daily basic cleanser, which honestly leeps my routine simple & effective.
